svg.title: Deployment effects depend on observation × state action
svg.desc: Two separate forest-plot panels show paired task-success changes for state actions relative to the same observation method's monitored no-state-action control: natural online deployment and an aggressive checkpoint-1 yoked sensitivity.
svg.text: Deployment effects depend on observation × state action
Success change versus each method’s monitored/no-state-action control; positive means the state action helped
A · Natural online deployment (primary ecological result)
40 paired tasks per row; effect = state action − the same method’s monitored/no-state-action control.
Right labels: tasks acted on / mean observed-checkpoint action rate under each separately deployed natural policy.

svg.text: B · Aggressive checkpoint-1 yoked sensitivity (controlled; not a replication)
Same 40 source tasks; every cell follows the active anchor’s checkpoint-1 schedule.
Tests operator sensitivity—not natural trigger timing—and has no feedback arm; estimates are never pooled with Panel A.
